label: GO-only, grows exponentially late in episode, scaled up when last state was S1 (esp. rewarded, a2->S1 r)
terms: (phase == GO) * np.exp(ep_trial/18) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/18) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/18) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/18) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/18) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1)
explanation: Fires only at GO; zero at D1/D2. Magnitude rises roughly exponentially with episode trial (~exp(ep_trial/18)), and the history effect is multiplicative with that ramp: after reaching S2 on the previous trial the activation is near zero (the generic late-episode term gets a negative weight that cancels it), while after reaching S1 it is large, larger still if S1 was rewarded, largest after a rare a2->S1 rewarded trial, and further boosted if the trial before was also S1 rewarded (streaks of S1 rewards build it up). Additive tables without the time interaction reach only 0.23 (all) / 0.19 (observed); these time-scaled observed-only terms give test R^2 beyond timing 0.376 (dev 0.377). Hidden good state, since_rev, policy logit and value added nothing (<0.01). Remaining misses: under-predicts long S1-reward streaks and some post-a2 S2 r steps.
